:::{#exm-joint-distribution}
#### Joint distribution of the first flip and the total

In @exm-jointly-distributed,
the joint distribution of $X_1$ and $X$ assigns to the set
$A = \set{(x_1, x) : x_1 = 1,\, x \ge 1}$ the probability

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Pr((X_1, X) \in A)
&= \Pr(\set{HH, HT}) \\
&= \tfrac{1}{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

since the first flip is heads exactly on $HH$ and $HT$,
and each of those outcomes has at least one head.

:::
